Changed:
• Cleanup is now deterministic. The same words get the same cleanup every time; the corpus passes 11 of 11 across five repeats with one output per case.
• Sentences always start with a capital. Applied as a rule after the model, like the final full stop, because the model left short casual sentences lowercase. Words with their own casing (iPhone, macOS) and abbreviations (e.g., a.m.) are left alone.
